high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue magazine, featuring a bride standing outdoors in a lush, green garden. The bride is wearing an elegant white wedding gown with intricate lace detailing. The dress has long sleeves and a fitted bodice that flares out into a mermaid-style skirt at the bottom. She is also wearing a long, flowing veil that cascades down her back. The background consists of tall trees and vibrant greenery, creating a serene and natural setting. The sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled shadows on the grassy ground.
